evidence.summary: Live on this PC's 7844-blocking network: block detected 74s after launch; tunnel held in 'blocked' with no restart between attempts; one fresh attempt per ~30 min (09:56 launch 1, then 10:27, 10:57, 11:27, 11:58, 12:28, 12:58, 13:28, 13:59) vs every 10 min on the old code (09:07-09:48). Other components untouched (api/web/worker healthy throughout). Stub test 38/0 covers /ready 200 ending the episode and the unchanged 10-min /ready rule. Self-verification by the implementation run.

rationale: The churn is bounded to one link change per 30 min while blocked and the hold is measured live. Limitation: recovery when the network allows 7844 (/ready 200 clears the block) was not observed live and is proven only by the stubbed test.
